serp_benchmark.title: Fashionably fit: Unveiling the athleisure trend in India
serp_benchmark.tone: Broad, explanatory and India-specific; cultural commentary rather than a shopping guide.
serp_benchmark.structure: Definition and origin; lockdown and hybrid-work context; athleisure versus streetwear; utility and forward-looking themes.
serp_benchmark.benchmark_takeaway: Retain the India context, but answer the practical styling question more directly and avoid unsupported market predictions.

serp_benchmark.title: The Quiet Revolution: How Athleisure Became Everyday Culture
serp_benchmark.tone: Editorial, reflective and culture-led with a magazine cadence.
serp_benchmark.structure: Roots of athleisure; social-media influence; daily routines; retail and cultural shifts; aesthetic and ethical questions; synthesis.
serp_benchmark.benchmark_takeaway: Use a strong cultural frame, then move quickly into scenarios and decisions the reader can use.

serp_benchmark.title: Athleisure In India: The Complete Gym-To-Street Guide
serp_benchmark.tone: Conversational, product-led and practical with founder-style commentary.
serp_benchmark.structure: Definition; product-by-product wardrobe build; occasion table; founder note; related articles; FAQs.
serp_benchmark.benchmark_takeaway: Match its utility and conversation, but use an original day-in-motion framework and OFFLIMITS-specific products and links.

combined_benchmark.target_tone: Conversational Indian sportstyle editorial with concrete outfit decisions.
combined_benchmark.target_structure: Cultural shift -> wardrobe building blocks -> day-part scenarios -> styling rules -> fit and buying checks -> conclusion -> FAQs.
combined_benchmark.originality_guardrail: Do not copy competitor phrasing, section titles or product logic verbatim.
